entries.이 약은 세균성 치은염(잇몸염), 구강 점막의 세균성 염증과 치주 수술: This medicine is used as temporary adjunctive therapy for bacterial gingivitis (inflammation of the gums), bacterial inflammation of the oral mucosa, and the period after periodontal surgery.
entries.이 약은 수술 전 환자의 피부소독 또는 주사기 바늘, 카테터 삽입 전 환: This medicine is used for disinfection of the patient's skin before surgery or before insertion of a syringe needle or a catheter.
entries.이 약은 습진, 피부염, 땀띠, 가려움, 벌레물린데, 두드러기에 사용합니: This medicine is used for eczema, dermatitis, heat rash, itching, insect bites, and urticaria.
entries.이 약은 습진, 피부염, 땀띠, 옻 등에 의한 피부염, 가려움, 벌레물림: This medicine is used for eczema, dermatitis, heat rash, dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like, itching, insect bites, urticaria, and chilblains.
entries.이 약은 심근경색, 뇌경색, 불안정형 협심증에서 혈전 생성 억제와 관상동: This medicine is used to inhibit thrombus formation in myocardial infarction, cerebral infarction, and unstable angina, to inhibit thrombus formation after coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG) or percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA), and to reduce cardiovascular risk in high-risk patients (patients with multiple risk factors such as a family history of ischemic heart disease, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, obesity, and diabetes).
This medicine is used for allergic conjunctivitis.
entries.이 약은 영양부족으로 인한 각막 및 결막의 궤양성 질환에 대한 영양공급,: This medicine is used to supply nutrition for ulcerative diseases of the cornea and conjunctiva caused by nutritional deficiency, and for microdamage to the cornea and conjunctiva caused by wearing contact lenses and the like.
entries.이 약은 위.십이지장궤양, 위염, 위산과다의 제산작용 및 증상의 개선에: This medicine is used for its antacid action and for improving the symptoms of gastric and duodenal ulcer, gastritis, and excess stomach acid.
entries.이 약은 위식도 역류의 증상 개선(산 역류, 속쓰림, 위 내용물의 역류로: This medicine is used to improve the symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux (acid reflux, heartburn, and indigestion caused by regurgitation of stomach contents (after meals, during pregnancy, or when accompanied by reflux esophagitis)).
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신 및 수유기, 병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후의 체력: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B2 and B6 in cases of physical fatigue, during pregnancy and breastfeeding, and when physical strength is reduced during or after an illness. Through the vitamins it contains, this medicine is used to relieve the symptoms of angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, and dermatitis. This medicine is used for muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신·수유기, 병중·병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B2, B6, and C in cases of physical fatigue, during pregnancy and breastfeeding, and when physical strength is reduced during or after an illness, to relieve pigmentation (melasma, freckles) caused by sunlight, skin disease, and the like, and to prevent bleeding gums and nosebleeds.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신ㆍ수유기, 병중ㆍ병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used to supply vitamins E, B1, B2, and B6 in cases of physical fatigue, during pregnancy and breastfeeding, when physical strength is reduced during or after an illness, and in old age, and for neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (low back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation inside the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, dermatitis, beriberi, and eye fatigue.
entries.이 약은 인후통, 춥고 떨리는 증상의 오한, 발열, 두통, 관절통, 근육: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold, such as sore throat, chills with feeling cold and shivering, fever, headache, joint pain, and muscle pain.
entries.이 약은 장내균총 이상(항생물질, 화학요법제 투여 등)에 의한 정장, 변: This medicine is used to regulate the bowels and to improve constipation, loose stools, abdominal bloating, and abnormal fermentation in the intestines caused by an abnormal intestinal flora (from administration of antibiotics, chemotherapeutic agents, etc.).
This medicine is used as adjunctive therapy for symptoms of mental and physical asthenia.
entries.이 약은 치열 및 치핵의 아픔이나 가려움, 부종이나 출혈의 일시적 완화에: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of pain or itching, swelling, and bleeding from anal fissures and hemorrhoids.
entries.이 약은 치은염, 구내염, 인두염, 후두염, 발치 전·후에 의한 통증 및: This medicine is used to relieve pain and inflammation caused by gingivitis, stomatitis, pharyngitis, laryngitis, and tooth extraction (before and after), and for disinfection.
entries.이 약은 코감기(급성비염(코염)), 알레르기성 비염(코염) 또는 부비동염: This medicine is used to relieve nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a head cold (acute rhinitis (nasal inflammation)), allergic rhinitis (nasal inflammation), or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 코감기, 알레르기성 비염, 또는 부비동염에 의한 코막힘, 콧물,: This medicine is used to relieve the symptoms of nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a head cold, allergic rhinitis, or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 통증으로 인한 일시적인 불면을 동반하는 급성 야간 통증에 사용합: This medicine is used for acute night-time pain accompanied by temporary insomnia caused by the pain.
entries.이 약은 피부사상균에 의한 피부진균(곰팡이)감염증(무좀, 완선(사타구니백: This medicine is used for fungal skin infections caused by dermatophytes (athlete's foot, jock itch (tinea cruris), ringworm).
entries.이 약은 해열 및 감기로 인한 통증, 두통, 근육통, 월경통, 치통, 허: This medicine is used to reduce fever and to relieve pain caused by a cold, headache, muscle pain, menstrual pain, toothache, low back pain, and joint pain.
entries.이 약을 다른 점안제와 동시에 사용할 경우에는 다른 점안제를 사용하고 약: When using this medicine at the same time as other eye drops, instill this medicine about 10 minutes after using the other eye drops.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 비스테로이드성 소염(항염)진통제, 무좀치료제 및: Before taking this medicine, patients taking non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, athlete's foot treatments and antifungal agents (such as itraconazole and posaconazole oral suspension), or tyrosine kinase inhibitors (dasatinib, erlotinib, gefitinib, pazopanib, etc.) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Patients receiving intravenous lipid preparations should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 다른 진토제, 감기약, 해열진통제, 항히스타민제,: While taking this medicine, do not take other antiemetics, cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, antihistamines, sedatives, antitussives and expectorants, or alcoholic drinks.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 항생제,: While taking this medicine, do not take phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline antibiotics, or antacids. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take it together with antialdosterone agents, triamterene, or 200 mg or more of ascorbic acid (vitamin C). Avoid tea containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, and milk and dairy products while taking it and just before or after taking it.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제,: While taking this medicine, do not take antitussives and expectorants, other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines. People who are taking an MAO inhibitor used for depression, Parkinson's disease, and the like, or who stopped taking one within the past 2 weeks, should not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, people who are receiving diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, or steroids should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Patients who have taken barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, or alcohol should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol when taking it.
While taking this medicine, do not take tetracycline antibiotics.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 눈의 통증이 심한 환자, 지금까지 안약에 의한 알: Before using this medicine, patients with severe eye pain, people who have previously had allergic symptoms from eye drops (redness of the eye, itching, swelling, rash, congested and reddened skin), and patients with glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When using it in a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for instillation into the eye only. After opening, use it immediately and only once, and be sure to discard the remaining solution and the container. Do not use it if it has become cloudy (turbid). To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 2 weeks of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 이 약에 과민증 환자, 12세 미만의 소아는 의사: Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and children under 12 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 중증 심부전, 신부전 환자는 의사 또는 약사와 상: Before using this medicine, patients with severe heart failure or renal failure should consult a doctor or pharmacist. This medicine must be used locally; do not use it as a parenteral injection. Do not use it if systemic absorption may occur. Do not use it if there is floating matter in it or if the container is damaged. When using it for irrigation, use a newly opened container and do not reuse the remaining solution.
entries.이 약의 사용으로 인해 발진·발적, 가려움 등의 증상이 나타나는 경우 사: If symptoms such as rash and redness or itching occur from using this medicine, stop using it and consult a pharmacist or doctor.
entries.이상증상, 알레르기 반응 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사: If abnormal symptoms or an allergic reaction occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not reuse it after a single use. After instillation, discard the remaining solution and the container. Do not let the tip of the container touch anything. Do not use the solution if its color has changed or if it has become cloudy. If you accidentally swallow this medicine, get help from a doctor immediately.
entries.적용부위에 화상, 결막염, 눈자극, 눈물흘림 증가, 탈모, 지각과민, 모: Burns at the application site, conjunctivitis, eye irritation, increased tearing, hair loss, hypersensitivity of sensation, folliculitis, pustules, rash, tenderness, acne, hair loss, dry skin, skin disorders, abnormal hair texture, change in hair color, folliculitis, taste disturbance, and urticaria may occur. If hypersensitivity symptoms or a feeling of irritation occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.정해진 용법과 용량을 잘 지키십시오.어린이에게 투여할 경우 보호자의 지도: Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only; do not swallow it. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Because it forms poorly soluble salts with anions, use clean distilled water when diluting it. Before use, wash off the contaminants on and around the wounded area thoroughly and then use it.
Do not take this medicine within 1 hour after taking an antacid or consuming milk.
entries.졸음, 두통, 혈관염, 광과민증, 현기증, 관절통, 인두염, 기침, 코피: If drowsiness, headache, vasculitis, photosensitivity, dizziness, joint pain, pharyngitis, cough, nosebleed, bronchospasm, hearing abnormalities, visual abnormalities, occasionally elevated BUN, glycosuria, or blood in the urine, or rarely difficulty urinating, bedwetting, or urinary retention occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If itching and/or urticaria appears after this medicine has been stopped, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.중증 또는 조절되지 않는 고혈압 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약: Patients with severe or uncontrolled high blood pressure should not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants under 2 years of age, people with heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, glaucoma, or a breathing disorder such as asthma or chronic bronchitis, and people taking sedatives or tranquilizers should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. If symptoms do not improve within 7 days or if a fever develops, stop taking it and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.진해거담제(가래약), 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제, 항히스타민제를: Do not take together with antitussives and expectorants (phlegm medicines), other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines). Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take it together with barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, alcohol, potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, etacrynic acid) or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide), diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, or steroids. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
entries.진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제, 항히스타민제를 함유하는: Do not take together with antitussives and expectorants, other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines). Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take it together with barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, alcohol, potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, etacrynic acid) or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide), diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, or steroids. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
entries.충혈되어 붉어짐, 부종(부기), 자극감, 화농(곪음), 알레르기증상(발진: If congested and reddened skin, swelling (edema), irritation, suppuration (festering), allergic symptoms (rash, congested and reddened skin, itching, etc.), or bleeding occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.클로르헥시딘, 이소프로판올 또는 황색 5호에 과민증, 2개월 이하의 영유: People with hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine, isopropanol, or Yellow No. 5 and infants aged 2 months or younger should not use this medicine. Do not use this medicine for disinfecting surgical instruments, or on nervous tissue (e.g., brain or spinal cord tissue), the eyes, ears, mouth, mucous membranes, genital mucous membranes, open wounds, or torn or damaged skin, or for general washing of the skin. Before using this medicine, people with hypersensitivity to other medicines, people who have experienced allergic diseases such as asthma or who have a family history of them, people with hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine preparations, and people with a drug-hypersensitive constitution should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it externally only on intact skin. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so be careful not to let it get into the eyes; if it does get in, rinse thoroughly with clean water immediately.
entries.테트라사이클린계 항생물질과 함께 복용하지 마십시오.비스테로이드소염진통제(: Do not take together with tetracycline antibiotics. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take it together with non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (NSAIDs), ulcer medicines, digitalis preparations, chlorpromazine, lansoprazole, prednisolone, penicillin, quinolones, iron (Fe) salt preparations, or salicylates.
entries.통증, 시야의 변화, 지속적인 눈의 충혈 또는 자극감을 경험하거나, 증상: If you experience pain, changes in vision, or persistent redness or irritation of the eye, or if symptoms worsen or last for more than 72 hours, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.투석요법을 받는 환자, 만 3개월 미만의 젖먹이, 갈락토오스 불내성, L: Patients receiving dialysis, nursing infants under 3 months of age, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption should not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, nursing infants aged 3 months to under 1 year, patients with renal impairment, people with an allergic constitution, and people on a sodium-restricted diet should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 2 weeks of use, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly.
Do not use together with povidone-iodine disinfectants.
entries.피부, 창상면, 점막의 세정, 습포, 함소, 분무흡입, 의료용 기구의 세: Use an appropriate amount for cleansing the skin, wound surfaces, and mucous membranes, for wet compresses, gargling, and spray inhalation, and for cleaning medical instruments.
entries.피부염, 땀ㆍ호흡 시 악취, 탈모, 조급증, 구토, 알레르기 등이 나타나: If dermatitis, a foul odor of sweat and breath, hair loss, restlessness, vomiting, or allergy occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.피부진균증에 사용하는 경우 1일 1회(가능하면 취침시) 환부를 깨끗이 닦: When using it for a fungal skin infection, once a day (at bedtime if possible), wipe the affected area clean, dry it completely, then apply a thin layer to the affected area and the surrounding skin and rub it in gently. When using it for a fungal nail infection (fingernails, toenails), cut the nails short and apply a thin layer once a day (at bedtime if possible) or, if necessary, twice a day (morning and evening). To prevent recurrence, continue using it for about 2 more weeks after all symptoms have disappeared.
Instill 1 to 2 drops (put into the eye) as needed. Adjust the amount appropriately according to symptoms. Discard the remaining solution and the container immediately after instillation.
entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안하고, 점안 후 남은 액과 용기: As needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye, and after instillation discard the remaining solution and the container. When using it at the same time as other eye drops, instill them at least 15 minutes apart to avoid a dilution effect.
entries.항암요법으로 고용량 메토트렉세이트를 투여중인 환자, 다른 비스테로이드성: Patients receiving high-dose methotrexate as cancer chemotherapy should not take this medicine, and do not take this medicine together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics. Before taking this medicine, people taking low-dose aspirin or ACE inhibitors and patients taking lithium, furosemide and thiazide diuretics, low-dose methotrexate, coumarin anticoagulants (such as warfarin), or selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.호흡곤란, 온몸이 붉어짐, 혈관부기, 두드러기 등의 쇽 증상 혹은 천식발: If shock symptoms such as difficulty breathing, reddening of the whole body, angioedema, or urticaria, or an asthma attack, thrombocytopenia, granulocytopenia, hemolytic anemia, methemoglobinemia, decreased platelet function (prolonged bleeding time), or hypersensitivity symptoms such as cyanosis, facial swelling, sweating, or low blood pressure, or nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, gastrointestinal bleeding, peptic ulcer, perforation, rash, Stevens-Johnson syndrome (mucocutaneous ocular syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), elevated AST, elevated ALT, or fixed drug eruption occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.환부의 크기와 삼출물의 정도에 따라 적절한 양을 1일 2~3회 감염된 피: Apply an appropriate amount to the infected skin 2 to 3 times a day, depending on the size of the affected area and the amount of exudate. This medicine may be used alternately with a cream or a solution. In the case of athlete's foot, it is advisable to spray it on shoes and socks to dry up moisture and prevent reinfection. The treatment period varies according to the severity and location of the disease. In general, it is used for 3 to 4 weeks for fungal skin infections, 1 to 3 weeks for tinea versicolor, 2 to 4 weeks for erythrasma, and 1 to 2 weeks for candidal perineal inflammation. Use it regularly for a sufficient period to obtain the full therapeutic effect. If mycological cure has not been achieved, treatment is generally continued for about 2 more weeks after all symptoms have disappeared.
